name: app-main-hardening
summary: Desktop main: parser, exec, pty and bridge fixes
body:
porcelain=v2 rename records carry a score field and deliver the
original path as the next NUL record — the parser consumed the score
as the path and could misread the continuation as a new entry;
unmerged records are now read too. git log trailers unfold with an
explicit separator (folded values split records; multiple trailers
fused into a bogus id). Spawn failures in GitService resolve to
Result errors instead of unhandled rejections crossing IPC; exec
decodes output once (per-chunk decoding tore multi-byte UTF-8);
pty:create failures surface as structured errors; the preload bridge
enforces the channel allowlist at runtime; pty sessions are reaped
when the last window closes; smoke mode fails fast on load errors.
Found by adversarial self-review.
